title: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
description: Light and airy pancakes with a tender crumb and golden exterior. The buttermilk adds tang and helps create the perfect fluffy texture that makes these pancakes irresistible.
instructions:
1. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together buttermilk, eggs, melted butter, and vanilla extract.
3. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and pour in the wet ingredients. Stir gently until just combined - a few lumps are okay.
4. Heat a griddle or large non-stick pan over medium heat. Lightly grease with butter or cooking spray.
5. Pour 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake onto the hot griddle. Cook until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set, about 2-3 minutes.
6. Flip and cook until golden brown on the other side, about 1-2 minutes more.
7. Serve immediately with maple syrup, butter, and fresh berries.
